title: ATB loop-closure ledger entry
description: A single entry in the overseer meta-layer's loop-closure ledger (Phase 2). It tracks ONE recurrence CLASS surfaced by an EXISTING detector (coach loop / Improvement Feeder / diff-gate hold) from detection -> decision, so a noticed weakness can never be silently dropped. The ledger adds NO new detector: an entry is keyed to existing-detector artifacts only. It NEVER authors a verdict — a resolved entry must CITE a trusted overseer-decision-record (the governance binding); the loop_closure_check tool only records and reconciles the binding, never judges which weakness is real or which layer to pick (doer != certifier). Schema-valid != sound.

class_id.description: Stable, unique recurrence-class id (e.g. lcc-coder-contract-shape-fidelity). One class = one recurring weakness, NOT one raw lesson (class granularity). Immutable once logged.

created_ts.description: UTC timestamp the ledger entry was authored (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

target_agent.description: The agent/actor the recurring weakness concerns (coder/qa/main/dreamer/research, or an improver pointed UP: codex/overseer/system). The cited decision-record's target_agent MUST match (the check enforces it).

detector.description: Which EXISTING detector surfaced this class. Closed set on purpose — the meta-layer adds no new detector; extending this enum is a deliberate, reviewed schema change, never a silent one.

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of the recurring weakness (renders in the audit digest).

source_refs.description: The existing-detector artifacts this class is keyed to (>=1). Each anchors the class to a real, identifiable detector output with its content hash, so an entry cannot be a fabricated abstraction. Re-hashing against the live artifact is the meta-audit's job (Phase 3); this schema enforces the anchor's shape.

source_id.description: Immutable id of the detector artifact (e.g. coach:<job_id>:r<round>, an Improvement-Feeder class id, or an events.jsonl gate-hold event id).

hash.description: Content hash of the detector artifact at the time this class was logged (tamper-evidence / drift anchor).

note.description: Optional human note about this source.

status.description: open = detected, no decision recorded yet (surfaced by the check, never a hold — work in progress). resolved = a decision has been recorded; decision_record MUST cite it. The KIND of resolution (layer-rewrite / no_change / defer) is read from the cited TRUSTED record, not asserted here (single source of truth).

decision_record.description: The overseer-decision-record id that resolves this class (the governance binding). Required iff status=resolved; forbidden iff status=open.

supersedes.description: The class_id of a prior entry this one revisits/replaces, if any.

allOf.$comment: A resolved class MUST cite the governance decision-record that closed it.
An open class has no decision yet, so it MUST NOT cite one (citing a record = resolved).
